relationship: Constructed pattern stages generate terms and successive differences that can justify an nth-term rule or expose an incorrect one.

learnerLoop.action: Build the next pattern stage, inspect its sequence data and decide on a future term or rule.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Placed squares, term values and differences update.
learnerLoop.evidence: The lattice construction, sequence table and verification feedback connect growth to the rule.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Place another square, compare differences or revise the proposed nth term.

invariants: Each term corresponds to the completed stage construction.
Successive differences describe the change between consecutive terms.
safeAdaptations: Vary buildable pattern rules and stage numbers.
Adjust working support while retaining a direct construction-to-sequence link.
nonGoals: Accepting an nth-term rule without checking it against constructed stages.

task.description: Current problem statement and supplied quantities.
task.visibility: Shown at the start of each problem or stage.

model.description: Operated construction and its live measurements; see quantities for what is given and revealed.
model.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

working.description: Ordered calculations, learner entries and consequential evidence for the current task.
working.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

completion.description: Achievement, next task or learning transition.
completion.visibility: Shown only when the local completion conditions below are satisfied; representation controls are separately identified.

progress.description: Current term values, construction feedback and working diagnosis.
progress.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

stages.description: Existing family progression and earned support levels.
stages.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

terms-and-squares.description: Stage counts T1, T2, … and the spatial pattern they count.
terms-and-squares.domain: Nonnegative integer square counts and connected lattice cells.
terms-and-squares.source: The preceding stage is given; learner places/removes squares to extend the construction.
terms-and-squares.output: Stage counts and the term strip update from placement.

difference-rule-use.description: Difference entries, one nth-term expression and one requested Tn value. Labels T1/T2 and step numbers identify positions, not independent scalar unknowns.
difference-rule-use.domain: Integer differences/term values; algebraic expression in n.
difference-rule-use.source: Required entries vary by Working level and family.
difference-rule-use.output: Rule entry unlocks after construction; the use value waits for a required rule to be correct.

ambiguous-futures.description: Two different values of T4 for the same prefix, produced by two constructions.
ambiguous-futures.source: Learner constructs both; no unique nth-term rule is demanded in this family.
ambiguous-futures.output: The two future counts are compared in working.

modes.none: Build the pattern; differences, rule and use value are revealed as construction completes.
modes.some: Enter the invariant difference, nth-term rule and requested later term.
modes.all: Enter all difference rows, nth-term rule and requested term.
modes.availability: Some/All are earned through completed patterns. The ambiguity family instead requires two different connected fourth-stage constructions.

dependencies: A valid extension advances the constructed stage.
requiredWorkKeys() selects invariant-only or all difference entries; construction gates formula entry and a correct required formula gates use.
The final ambiguity task uses two distinct constructed futures rather than calculation-field completion.
implementation.completion: stageFinished() is constructionComplete() && workingReady(), except the ambiguity family where state.futures.length >= 2 completes the stage.
